title: Unramified coefficient DVR extension and compatible complete local lifting
statement: Let $W$ be a complete discrete valuation ring of mixed characteristic $(0,p)$, with uniformizer $\pi$ and perfect residue field $k_0=W/\pi W$ [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $k'/k_0$ be any field extension. Then there are a complete discrete valuation ring $V$, an injective local map $W\to V$, and an isomorphism $V/\pi V\cong k'$ inducing the specified map on $k_0$. In particular $\pi$ is a uniformizer of $V$. The map $W\to V$ is formally smooth for the maximal-ideal-adic topologies [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Moreover, let $(C,\mathfrak n)$ be a complete Noetherian local $W$-algebra with local structure map, and let $s:k'\to C/\pi C$ be a $k_0$-algebra map inducing an isomorphism $k'\cong C/\mathfrak n$. Then the composite $V\to k'\xrightarrow{s}C/\pi C$ lifts to a local $W$-algebra homomorphism $V\to C$.

source.place: Expose IV 4.2.5, first paragraph (formally smooth coefficient extension W_0′→V), second paragraph (lifting V→A′); supporting stated results IV 4.1.3–4.1.6.
